stories.title: Nobelpreis 2026 – Der Friedensnobelpreis geht an Navanethem «Navi» Pillay

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize 2026 – Peace Nobel Prize awarded to Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay
en.summary: South African jurist Navanethem Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize for her work promoting peace and international law.

stories.title: Le Nobel de la paix décerné à la Sud-Africaine Navanethem Pillay

en.title: Peace Nobel awarded to South African Navanethem Pillay
en.summary: The 85-year-old South African jurist Navanethem Pillay won the Nobel Peace Prize for her commitment to international law and her leadership of a UN independent investigation commission.

stories.title: La Sud-Africaine Navanethem "Navi" Pillay reçoit le prix Nobel de la paix

en.title: South African Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay receives Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: The Nobel Committee awarded the 2026 Peace Prize to South African jurist Navanethem Pillay for her commitment to international law and leading an independent UN investigation.

stories.title: Sie setzte sich für Gerechtigkeit in Rwanda ein: Die südafrikanische Richterin «Navi» Pillay gewinnt den Friedensnobelpreis

en.title: She championed justice in Rwanda: South African judge 'Navi' Pillay wins the Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: South African judge Navanethem Pillay has been named the recipient of the Nobel Peace Prize, selected from 287 nominated individuals and organizations.

stories.title: Fort du soutien du candidat arrivé troisième au 1er tour, Flavio Bolsonaro se rapproche encore du pouvoir

en.title: Supported by third-place candidate from first round, Flavio Bolsonaro moves closer to power
en.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro, secured endorsement from third-place first-round candidate Augusto Cury. This strengthens his position as favourite against incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Rechenzentrum des russischen Technologiekonzerns Yandex beschädigt +++ Tote und Stromausfälle in Kiew

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Data center of Russian technology company Yandex damaged +++ Deaths and power outages in Kyiv
en.summary: A Russian technology company's data center has been damaged during the ongoing conflict in Ukraine. Deaths and power outages have been reported in Kyiv.

stories.title: Un incendie dans un conduit de câbles près d’Eclépens perturbe le trafic CFF entre Lausanne et Yverdon

en.title: Fire in cable duct near Eclépens disrupts CFF traffic between Lausanne and Yverdon
en.summary: A fire in a cable duct near Eclépens has disrupted train traffic between Lausanne and Yverdon-les-Bains. Rail service is interrupted between two stations, with replacement buses deployed while authorities investigate the cause.

stories.title: Trump genehmigt Hinrichtung durch Erschiessen für Fort-Hood-Attentäter – und will diese offenbar per Livestream übertragen

en.title: Trump approves execution by firing squad for Fort Hood attacker – and apparently wants to livestream it
en.summary: President Donald Trump has authorized a military execution by firing squad, which would be the first since 1961. Reports indicate he may attempt to livestream the execution.

stories.title: La police enquête sur l'incendie qui perturbe la circulation des trains entre Lausanne et Yverdon-les-Bains

en.title: Police investigate fire disrupting train traffic between Lausanne and Yverdon-les-Bains
en.summary: A fire in a cable conduit near Eclépens station has halted all train service between Eclépens and Chavornay since Friday morning, severely disrupting the Lausanne-Yverdon rail line. Police are investigating the incident.

stories.title: Au Brésil, Flavio Bolsonaro obtient le soutien du candidat arrivé 3e au premier tour de la présidentielle

en.title: In Brazil, Flavio Bolsonaro secures support from third-place first-round presidential candidate
en.summary: Conservative candidate Flavio Bolsonaro, who led the first round with 47 percent of votes, has gained endorsement from Augusto Cury and other minor candidates who collectively received over 5 percent in the first round of Brazil's presidential election.

en.title: War in Ukraine – Zelenskyy: 78 killed in Russian attacks over past two days
en.summary: The Ukrainian president reports that 78 people have been killed in Russian attacks over the last two days.

en.title: By firing squad – Military execution in Texas: Pentagon apparently plans livestream
en.summary: The Pentagon reportedly plans to livestream the execution by firing squad of a military psychiatrist sentenced to death, scheduled for early December.

en.summary: Financial authorities have fined Volkswagen 1.2 million euros.

stories.title: Deutsch-französische Uneinigkeit: Ein gemeinsamer europäischer Kampfpanzer ist Geschichte

en.title: German-French disagreement: A joint European battle tank is history
en.summary: Germany has ended its participation in the joint MGCS tank project with France, following the earlier termination of the FCAS fighter jet programme, marking another setback for European defense cooperation initiatives.

stories.title: Entführungen auf offener Strasse: wie die Militärjunta in Myanmar Soldaten rekrutiert

en.title: Abductions on open streets: how Myanmar's military junta recruits soldiers
en.summary: Myanmar's military conscripts soldiers through forced recruitment on streets to fight against its population and ethnic rebels, with conscription mandatory until age 35 unless individuals can pay to avoid service.

stories.title: Ein Wiedereinstieg in die Kernenergie würde den Strom in Deutschland billiger und sauberer machen

en.title: A return to nuclear energy would make electricity in Germany cheaper and cleaner
en.summary: A study by think tank R21 indicates that combining nuclear power with renewable energy could resolve Germany's energy challenges. Technical feasibility exists for nuclear reentry, though political obstacles remain.

stories.title: Stellenabbau bei Tamedia: Das Medienhaus kämpft mit fortgesetztem Umsatzschwund

en.title: Job cuts at Tamedia: The media company struggles with continued revenue decline
en.summary: Switzerland's largest private editorial network is undergoing another round of staff reductions. Digital subscriptions have been unable to offset declining revenue from print operations.
